operations.name: Map Signals
operations.desc: Sweep the region's open channels. Raises Intel Level and grants Intel.

operations.name: Build Local Network
operations.desc: Recruit quiet local contacts. Improves Local Network for future work here.

operations.name: Counter Influence
operations.desc: Disrupt the rival network's foothold. Reduces Rival Influence, draws attention.

operations.name: Stabilize Region
operations.desc: Coordinate with local institutions. Raises Stability, lowers Public Pressure.

operations.name: Reduce Heat
operations.desc: Scrub trails and cool the Directorate's profile. Lowers global Heat.

operations.name: Trace Rival Cell
operations.desc: Follow the rival's threads to their source. The main path to victory.

operations.name: Emergency Containment
operations.desc: Commit everything to hold a failing region. Expensive, but it works fast.

operations.name: Deep Analysis
operations.desc: Cross-reference every file on this region. Reveals the hidden tag and sharpens odds.
operations.effect_hint: Reveal hidden tag, Intel Level to max

operations.name: Quiet Audit
operations.desc: Put the books in order before someone asks. Restores Trust, calms pressure.
